title: Chapter test: Writing Automated Tests
summary: Ten questions on writing, running and organizing tests. You need 70% to pass; you can retry and your best score is kept.

questions.q: Which attribute marks a function as a test?
questions.explanation: `#[cfg(test)]` is for the module; `#[test]` for each test function.
The condition is true, so the message is never used.

questions.q: Which assertion prints both values when it fails?
questions.explanation: `assert!` only prints the expression text unless you add a message.

questions.q: A unit test in `mod tests` inside `src/lib.rs` can call a private function defined in `src/lib.rs`.

questions.q: Which statements about doc tests are true?
options: They are code blocks in `///` comments
They can only test private functions
They keep documentation examples from going stale
questions.explanation: They use the public API, like any reader would.
